# Paths the product tree does not accept, checked by `merge-gate` on every pull
# request into the default branch.
#
# The rule these encode is stated in the delivery protocol: the product
# repository carries code. Planning documents, audit notes, review reports and
# pending-patch files are workspace artefacts; they live in the agents'
# workspace repository and never enter the product repository. Before this list
# existed the rule was prose, and prose is not a gate.
#
# The list names artefacts by the names they carry in the product tree's own
# language, which is English; the workspace repository's Turkish-named
# documents never reach this tree at all, and `preflight-budlum` in the
# workspace refuses a push that carries one.
#
# Forms:
#   trailing `/`   a directory, matched as a path prefix
#   containing `/` a path prefix
#   leading `*`    a suffix match over the base name
#   anything else  an exact base name, at any depth
#
# A pull request that *deletes* one of these paths is not an offence: the diff
# is read with `--diff-filter=d`, so removal is how the tree gets clean.
review-notes/
docs/audit/
*.patch
*.diff
PLAN.md
*_PLAN.md
*_REPORT.md
